description: A maximal terminator applies in a nested query too, where no terminator is written. On A B, r could read y as A and leave out [T], but y → A B is longer in the query's chart, so the omission is forbidden. begins of r is false, and the rejection is an ordinary one (engine §4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%elidable maximal T
%rule text A B
%conditions begins(from($), r)
%rule r y [T] B
%rule y A | A B
